machines.name: Onefinity Elite Journeyman Gen 1 · Makita RT0701C

provenance.note: Onefinity publishes 600 IPM rapids; Makita publishes 10,000–30,000 RPM and 1.25 maximum HP. Feed is a travel ceiling, not a qualified cutting feed. Cutspace enables an illustrative curve using 932 W, torque derived at 30,000 RPM and a 75% usable-output reserve. Maximum HP does not establish continuous mechanical output, so this curve must be replaced by measured data for capacity claims.

provenance.note: Redline publishes 2.2 kW and 8,000–24,000 RPM; Onefinity publishes 600 IPM rapids. Feed is a travel ceiling, not a qualified cutting feed. The 0.875 N·m plateau is derived from rated power at 24,000 RPM; Cutspace's constant-torque curve and 75% usable-output reserve are modeling assumptions, not a measured spindle curve.

LMT Onsrud recommends solid-carbide O-flute tooling and gives 0.004–0.012 in/tooth as a general plastics range. A firsthand Makita/HOZLY slot cut at 70 IPM and roughly 18,000–22,500 RPM brackets chipload near 0.079–0.099 mm/tooth, so 0.075 mm is an empirical exploration threshold, not a proven minimum. Kc 230 N/mm², 350 m/min, deflection and force/power allowances remain unvalidated assumptions.

Representative O-flute geometry for exploring the polycarbonate starter. Measure diameter, cutting-edge count, flute length and actual stickout on the installed cutter before relying on geometry or deflection results.

tools.name: HOZLY 1/8 in · single flute · DLC · B09ZTW9V5D

provenance.note: User-identified cutter used successfully for a full-width polycarbonate profile slot. The listing states solid carbide, one flute, 1/8 in cutting diameter and shank, 17 mm cutting length, and DLC coating. The 20 mm stickout is an unmeasured placeholder; replace it with the installed value before interpreting deflection.

recipes.name: Reported polycarbonate slot · Makita · HOZLY 1/8 in

machine.name: Onefinity Elite Journeyman Gen 1 · Makita RT0701C

recipes.notes: Firsthand result: polycarbonate profile slot at 70 IPM with at least 0.125 in DOC, Makita RT0701C, and HOZLY B09ZTW9V5D 1/8 in single-flute DLC carbide cutter. Full-width slot and 1×D DOC are confirmed. The 18,000 RPM point comes from PenguinCAM's published polycarbonate default and is consistent with the operator's approximate recollection, but actual router RPM was not recorded. Stickout is assumed at 20 mm. The 200 µm roughing deflection allowance prevents an unmeasured tolerance assumption from rejecting the observed cut; it is not measured deflection or proof of dimensional accuracy.

provenance.note: Successful cut reported firsthand by the operator; feed, minimum DOC, cutter, router and slotting engagement confirmed. RPM, stickout, edge quality and dimensional accuracy were not measured.
